title: Condé Nast Traveler - Travel Reviews, News, Guides & Tips
content:
Searching closer to home for a coastal family getaway this year? From Puerto Rico to Wisconsin, Americans can get creative in their quest for sun and sand.

From favorite cities with new hotel and restaurant openings to rural retreats and island getaways.

Long evenings bleeding into warm nights made for zipping around on a red Vespa. Gelato melting faster than you can eat it. Aperitifs and sardines at a delightfully chaotic taverna. Nothing spells summer like a European sojourn. While Paris, Rome, and Lisbon will always have our hearts, quieter versions are beckoning, too. Pristine Italian islands. Design-obsessed Northern capitals. Cobblestoned old towns in Estonia few tourists have discovered. Whether you're in the mood to revisit the evergreen favorites or sidestep the crowds entirely, we have you covered.

Sunscreen's a given, but it's not the only necessity.

As the most discerning, up-to-the-minute voice in all things travel,Condé Nast Traveleris the global citizen’s bible and muse, offering both inspiration and vital intel. We understand that time is the greatest luxury, which is whyCondé Nast Travelermines its network of experts and influencers so that you never waste a meal, a drink, or a hotel stay wherever you are in the world.
